svg.text: Online retail: revenue, customers and RFM segments (UCI Online Retail, Dec 2010 - Dec 2011)
Rendered from results/tables (SQL on DuckDB, full data: 519,828 net sales lines, 19,693 orders). Net merchandise revenue in GBP after removing cancellations, reversals, fees and duplicates.
